concepts.name: Python Execution Model, REPL, Scripts & Indentation

criteria.statement: Distinguishes interactive REPL mode from executing a .py script file.
Explains that Python uses indentation (4 spaces) rather than braces to define code blocks.
Articulates that Python variables are name bindings (references) to heap objects rather than fixed memory boxes.
Predicts aliasing effects when two names point to the same mutable object vs. shallow/deep copies.

concepts.name: Data Types, Type Conversion, Operators, Strings & I/O

criteria.statement: Converts user input() strings safely to int or float before arithmetic.
Applies floor division (//), modulo (%), and f-string formatting accurately.

concepts.name: Core Collections: Lists, Tuples, Dictionaries & Sets

criteria.statement: Selects appropriately between list (ordered, mutable), tuple (ordered, immutable), dict (key-value), and set (unique, unordered).
Explains why mutable lists cannot serve as dictionary keys or set elements.
